findings.issue: Title tag repeats the meta description phrasing almost exactly ('closing the gap between apprenticeships and students'), risking duplication in search results.

findings.issue: All-caps body text: text-transform: uppercase on 33 chars of body text
findings.fix: Long passages in uppercase are hard to read. We recognize words by shape (ascenders and descenders), which all-caps removes. Reserve uppercase for short labels and headings.

findings.issue: Cramped padding: <section> "how-it-works": children flush against border-bottom on bottom (no inset)
findings.fix: Text is too close to the edge of its container. Two shapes: (1) an element with its own text where the padding is too low for the font size, and (2) a wrapper with text-bearing children and near-zero padding against a visible boundary (border, outline, or non-transparent background) — children land flush against the boundary line. Add at least 8px (ideally 12–16px) of padding inside bordered, outlined, or colored containers.

findings.fix: More than two em-dashes (— or --) in body copy is an AI cadence tell. Use commas, colons, periods, or parentheses instead.

findings.issue: Numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03): Sequence: 01, 02, 03, 04
findings.fix: Numbered display markers as section labels (01, 02, 03) are the AI editorial scaffold one tier deeper than tracked eyebrow chips. If you find yourself reaching for them, choose a different section cadence.

findings.issue: Layout property animation: transition: width
findings.fix: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.issue: The 'Founder Story' section (section 6) largely repeats the content from the 'Problem/Solution' section (section 2). Specifically, the core problem description and the solution statement are nearly identical in both sections.
findings.fix: Rewrite the 'Founder Story' content to offer a unique perspective, perhaps focusing on the personal motivation, journey, or specific challenges overcome during development, rather than reiterating the general problem and solution already presented in section 2. For example, 'Too many students never hear about apprenticeships until it is too late. Employers who offer them struggle to reach the people who would benefit most' and 'giving students clear, early visibility of real opportunities and giving business owners a direct route to motivated candidates. The platform is live, and we are now scaling the tools on both sides of the match' are almost direct copies. The founder story should deepen the narrative, not just repeat it.
